# AI hasn’t just sped up content creation. | Mandar Marathe · LinkedIn · 2026-04-30

**Mandar Marathe**: Vice President Marketing at UPTIQ for 1 year 7 months with 20 years 11 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Co-Founder at Koppr, Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Indian Institute of Management, Sirmaur, and Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Great Lakes Institute of Management. Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India [IN].

---

AI hasn’t just sped up content creation.

It’s completely changed how our team at [UPTIQ](https://linkedin.com/company/uptiqai) thinks about scale.

In this video, [Prachi Prakash](https://linkedin.com/in/prakashprachi) breaks down the exact AI stack she uses — and it’s not just one tool. It’s a full workflow.

Here’s what stood out to me:
🔨 Sales calls, PDFs, webinars → turned into insights using NotebookLM
🔪 ChatGPT vs Claude → competing to sharpen prompts
⛏️ Jasper, Copy.ai → scaling blogs, ads & emails
🪚 Perplexity → fast research without the rabbit holes

One idea → repurposed into LinkedIn posts, emails, infographics, videos

What used to take days… now happens in hours.

But the biggest shift isn’t speed.

It’s leverage.

We’re no longer creating content from scratch every time.

We’re maximizing one strong idea across every channel.

That’s the real AI advantage.

# Everyone is talking about Large Language Models (LLMs) in banking and lending. | UPTIQ · LinkedIn · 2026-03-12

**UPTIQ**: Uptiq is a Financial AI platform that brings intelligent agents, powerful orchestration, and purpose-built suites together to help teams grow, originate, and serve continuously. The platform provides solutions for banking, credit unions, wealth management, and equipment finance. UPTIQ has 150-200 employees (+130% YoY), founded in 2022. Headquartered in McKinney, Texas, United States, with an office in Austin. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including India, United States, Ukraine, Spain, and Australia). Has $49M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

---

Everyone is talking about Large Language Models (LLMs) in banking and lending.

But here’s an important distinction:
An LLM integration is not an AI agent.

In this episode of our 𝑰𝒏𝒔𝒊𝒅𝒆 𝑼𝒑𝒕𝒊𝒒 video series, our host [Mandar Marathe](https://linkedin.com/in/mandarmarathe) chats with our Engineering Director [Utkarsh Ugale](https://linkedin.com/in/utkarshugale) who explains what it actually takes to build production-grade AI agents for commercial lending.

In this episode, we dive deep into:
• How AI agents support underwriting workflows
• Why explainability and compliance are non-negotiable in lending
• How Uptiq’s QORE platform helps teams build secure agents faster

Watch now!

Learn more about Uptiq's commercial lending suite: https://lnkd.in/gPjRDzJM
